title: Living in the Lafayette and Lincoln theaters
summary: He spent his time at the Lafayette and Lincoln theaters, paid for by his aunt or friends.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: All during this period you were up there with all those places then -- Lafayette, etc., -- I mean were you beginning to go to these places? Like the Lafayette?
Oh, listen. I lived in the Lafayette, and the Lincoln theater.
Because you had to have money to get in.
What I'm wondering is -- you had to get yourself some change to get in there --
Oh -- I used to -- I used to --. My aunt used to, you know.
Oh. She was good to you. You had it a little -- softer, compared to some people?
Yeah. She was good. Yeah, she was good.
Yeah, she was good. Then, I had friends that had money, you know.
-- they had, you know, money, when I had some I'd take him too.
Then you were really seeing all the top entertainment, in a sense.
Oh, yes, yes. Yes. I used to go -- I used to live in the Lafayette theater.
